sn51.8:1.1: Cattāro me bhikkhave iddhipādā || katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || viriyasamādhi || cittasamādhi || vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā || || Imesam kho bhikkhave catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgato arahaṃ {sammāsambuddho} ti vuccatī ti || || Ayam
